data.name: Endurance
data.description: Harsh conditions or long exertions do not easily tire you.

raw_tokens.value: Harsh conditions or long exertions do not easily tire you.

You gain a +%1 bonus on the following checks and saves: Swim checks made to resist nonlethal damage from exhaustion; Constitution checks made to continue running; Constitution checks made to avoid nonlethal damage from a forced march; Constitution checks made to hold your breath; Constitution checks made to avoid nonlethal damage from starvation or thirst; Fortitude saves made to avoid nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments; and Fortitude saves made to resist damage from suffocation. You may sleep in light or medium armor without becoming fatigued.|Feat_Endurance_SaveBonus
